recent_articles.title: Rajasthan Cabinet approves new industrial development policy with focus on talent economy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rajasthan** Cabinet approved a new industrial development policy focused on talent economy and private sector participation to create a world-class industrial infrastructure.  **Industries and Commerce Minister Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore** stated the policy would provide incentives for micro, small, and medium enterprises, one district one product, and the export sector. The policy aims to boost the state's economy to $350 billion by 2028-29.  The Cabinet also approved decisions on energy production, water conservation, and pensioners' welfare.

recent_articles.title: After High Court verdict, Hindu petitioners seek free entry for devotees at Bhojshala in Madhya Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hindu** petitioners have filed applications with the **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)** and the **Union Culture Ministry**, demanding free entry to the Bhojshala complex and the removal of "unauthorised Islamic symbols". They also requested that idols of Lord Hanuman and other Hindu deities be retrieved through a scientific excavation. The **Madhya Pradesh High Court** had declared the site a Vagdevi temple on May 15, quashing an earlier order allowing Muslims to offer namaz there.

recent_articles.title: Six missing after boat capsizes in Yamuna in U.P.’s Hamirpur; search underway - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Six** people, including children, went missing after a boat capsized in the Yamuna river on Wednesday evening. **Three** individuals were rescued by the boatman, while the remaining six remain unaccounted for.  The **District Magistrate**, **Chief Minister Adityanath**, and **BJP MLA Manoj Prajapati** have ordered rescue efforts to locate the missing persons. The **National Disaster Response Force** and **State Disaster Response Force** are assisting in the search.

recent_articles.title: Vedanta's demerged entities to trade by mid-June after split, says CEO - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vedanta Resources CEO Deshnee Naidoo** and **CFO Ajay Goel** announced that the demerger of the company into five independent sector-specific pure play companies is nearing completion. The demerger, effective May 1, will see shareholders receive four additional shares for each share held in Vedanta as of April 29th.  The listing and commencement of trading are expected by mid-June with **Vedanta Ltd.**'s board approval already in place. The demerger aims to simplify the company's structure and provide opportunities for global investors.

recent_articles.title: India, New Zealand to sign FTA on April 27; deal provides Indian exporters 100% duty-free access - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** and **New Zealand** will sign a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) on Monday, April 27, 2026. The agreement will remove tariffs on 100% of India's exports to New Zealand and either reduce or eliminate tariffs on 95% of current imports from New Zealand. Commerce Minister **Piyush Goyal** welcomed **Todd McClay**, New Zealand’s Minister for Trade & Investment, to New Delhi ahead of the signing ceremony. The FTA is one of the fastest-negotiated trade agreements India has entered into and includes provisions for student mobility, professional visas, and investment from New Zealand in India.

recent_articles.title: Export disruption hits ‘Bangalore Rose’ onion farmers; MP seeks urgent support - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K. Sudhakar**, MP for Chickballapur, has urged the **Union government** to intervene in the market distress faced by farmers cultivating the geographically indicated (GI) ‘Bangalore Rose’ onion. The onion's export-oriented nature has been disrupted due to geopolitical issues, leading to a sharp decline in prices and financial hardship for farmers.  **Dr. Sudhakar** has called for procurement interventions, alternative export markets, logistical support, and processing infrastructure development under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY) to address the crisis.

recent_articles.title: No woman will be happy with DMK, Congress: Piyush Goyal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, Union Minister for Commerce and Industries, criticized the **DMK-Congress** decision to defeat the women's reservation Bill, calling it a divisive move that further divides India.  He praised **Amit Shah**, Union Home Minister, who offered to increase seats in the state by 50% during Parliament discussions. Goyal emphasized Prime Minister Narendra Modi's commitment to inclusive development across all states and regions of India.

recent_articles.title: Modi should not play with ‘fire’, warns Stalin over delimitation issue - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M.K. Stalin**, president of the **DMK**, cautioned **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Minister Piyush Goyal** against making disrespectful remarks about Tamil Nadu and its people during his campaign for the Assembly elections. He expressed concern over proposed delimitation exercises, stating they could negatively impact progressive states like Tamil Nadu.  He criticized **Edappadi K. Palaniswami**, leader of the opposition, for his perceived lack of understanding of Dravidian ideology and accused the BJP of attempting to gain a foothold in Tamil Nadu by using the AIADMK as a "mask".

recent_articles.title: Delimitation will not affect southern States, says Goyal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, Union Commerce and Industry Minister, stated that the 33% reservation for women in Parliament and Assemblies will be implemented by 2029. He dismissed concerns about potential disadvantages to southern states, arguing that the increase is proportional nationwide. **M.K. Stalin**, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister, and others have been accused of promoting a false narrative on this issue.

recent_articles.title: Piyush Goyal interview | 'Delimitation will not affect southern States' - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, Union Minister for Commerce and Industry, defended the allocation of the first PM Mitra Park to Tamil Nadu, stating that if **the Narendra Modi government** were engaging in petty politics, it would have chosen a state under its control.  He clarified that the BJP government had previously sanctioned the park in Virudhunagar during his tenure as Textiles Minister.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu election 2026: If BJP were playing petty politics, State would not have got first PM Mitra Park, says Piyush Goyal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, **Union Minister for Commerce and Industry**, defended the government's proposed delimitation plan, stating that it would not disadvantage southern states. He refuted allegations of political motives, claiming the allocation of the first PM Mitra Park to Tamil Nadu was a non-issue compared to the broader national context.  **Goyal** also assured that the government would implement 33% reservation for women by 2029.

recent_articles.title: Prominent candidates in Chennai file nomination papers, set out to canvass votes - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Several candidates filed their nomination papers for the Tamil Nadu Assembly election on Monday, April 6, 2026. **Piyush Goyal**, accompanied by members of the BJP and AIADMK, supported **Tamilisai Soundararajan**'s bid for the Mylapore Taluk office.  **B. Valarmathi**, former Minister and AIADMK candidate for Thousand Lights, highlighted civic grievances in the constituency. **Aassan Maulaana**, Congress candidate for Velachery, will face off against M.K. Ashok of the AIADMK. **Ma. Subramanian**, Health Minister and DMK candidate for Saidapet, conducted door-to-door campaigns.  **Kanimozhi**, DMK deputy general secretary and MP, campaigned in various constituencies.
